description: Edit a text file in the project and return a unified diff of what changed. old_string must match the file byte for byte; it is matched against the raw file, never against the line-number column that read_file displays. By default it must appear exactly once, so include enough surrounding context to be unambiguous. Set replace_all only to replace every occurrence deliberately. Use write_file to create a new file. Prefer this over shell commands such as sed, tee, or output redirection for changing files.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project directory

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string; by default, exactly one occurrence is required
